name: Viewing Plane Distance Adjustment
aliases: Ray Divergence Reduction via Viewing Plane Distance
definition: Minimizes aliasing caused by ray divergence by adjusting the distance between the viewer's eye and the viewing plane, reducing the angle between neighboring rays.
summary: Viewing Plane Distance Adjustment minimizes aliasing in volume rendering by increasing the camera-to-plane distance to reduce ray divergence, distinct from lens-based corrections.
